# Axiom Relay legacy integration repository (retired)

> This repository is historical source only. It offers no live API, MCP,
> payment, crypto, agent, or execution surface.

Do not infer current availability, product behavior, pricing, security status,
or endpoints from files or examples in this repository.

- Current product: https://axiomrelay.io
- Live capabilities: https://axiomrelay.io/api/v1/capabilities
- Service discovery: https://axiomrelay.io/.well-known/axiom-services.json
- Agent Card: https://axiomrelay.io/.well-known/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI: https://axiomrelay.io/openapi.json
